title: Client and server
goal: Pass90 as an explicit number and return1.5 hours with server-side validation.
prerequisites: onec.p7; P1–P3; explicit contracts, types, collections and failure handling.
sections: Button handling, focus and dialogs belong toUI. Infobase access and reliable rules belong in an available server context. Thick and thin clients differ; local success does not prove a distributed design. Specify the target client and permitted operations before implementation.

ЧасыНаСервере receives only a number. ПроверитьЧасы reads the UI field and calls the server; neither form state nor document writing is an implicit contract. Convert the returned number to display text on the client.

Do not send every customer to obtain one total. A server method receives minimal typed inputs and returns required data. The client cannot provide trusted permission or price decisions; the server checks its own conditions. Test serialization and parameter types separately from arithmetic correctness.
90/60=1.5 without rounding or document updates. Validate type before range0…1440. String "90" and numeric1441 fail different checks: type versus allowed value.
A file infobase is not a network

File mode can teach client/server directives but does not fully reproduce network latency, clusters or parallel sessions. Separate compilation-contextPASSfrom distributedLIVE. Counting source lines or one local process is not measured network-call reduction.
Create the ПроверитьЧасы form command, bind its existing action and drag it to the command bar.90 displays1.5, or1,5 in Russian locale; the display separator does not alter the numeric result.

For each method, list caller, parameters and returned data. Test an allowed call and an unavailable operation in the wrong context. Count calls for an ordinary action. Do not fix context errors by enabling every capability indiscriminately; reduce dependencies to what is necessary.

A file-mode run proves method availability and this platform call, not network latency. Training-edition client/server limits do not prevent this local experiment. Network performance and licensed deployment require separate checks.
